seasons.title: Delivery Boys
seasons.arc_summary: The newly formed party takes courier jobs and stumbles into a conspiracy involving Ugathul skinwalkers, Embercall Inc., and illegal augury, culminating in their descent into the sewers and discovery of Grayson's necromantic manor beneath the Quiet Below.

seasons.title: The Black and White
seasons.arc_summary: After a catastrophic TPK at the Crowded Flea, the party is resurrected through the Black and White by the entity Aut, then exacts revenge on Hlarf and Tywelwyn while uncovering a cosmic invasion plan by six outer gods using radar dishes to crack the firmament.

seasons.title: The Pilgrimage
seasons.arc_summary: The rescue of Anaïs reveals the cosmic Narrative, and the party travels to Ragged Roost to attend a mysterious Pilgrimage, competing in a keystone scavenger hunt to secure passage aboard a colossal Strider bound for the Void Side Wall.

seasons.title: Cracks in the Firmament
seasons.arc_summary: During extended downtime, the party discovers a fracture in reality beneath Teller's Run, an imprisoned giant god, and a conspiracy to shatter the firmament — leading them to bomb the research facility and depart on the Pilgrimage.

seasons.title: The Strider
seasons.arc_summary: Aboard the colossal Strider, the party builds their heart Eerie, navigates deadly faction politics and the weekly Tithe, forges an alliance with the ancient Machine God, and accidentally destroys a member of the Narrative — stranding the Strider far beyond the known map.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In the first session of a new Færrin-set one-shot (now a two-shot), four members of the Velvet Mark — Archie, Salvatore, Branson, and Combo — are tasked by Father Marone to assassinate the Spark, leader of the upstart gang Pyrelight. En route to Teller's Run, they're pulled over by Threshold Authority officers, leading to a violent car chase that ends with the cops' car flipped and destroyed. After ditching their identifiable car at Feathers' shop for a disguise, they sneak into Teller's Run and discover the Spark presiding over a burning-stage spectacle with a cheering crowd.

shows.name: A Hunt of Metal and Vine

seasons.title: From Cagley's Shadow to the Voice of Many
seasons.arc_summary: Noah's Cagley Middle one-shot concludes as four 8th-grade heroes slay the Terror of Cagley, then Josh's new Scale one-shot opens with four high-ranking operatives descending onto a shattered Joker World. Across the three sessions they battle through demon swarms, infiltrate the vine-covered black-metal Quorum, solve its gear-and-riddle puzzles, and ultimately plunge through a bloodfall portal to rescue the divine heart Voice of Many — a child of Sigzil and grandchild of the Judge — in a desperate ten-round defense before escaping back to Scale headquarters.

seasons.title: The Husk Murders
seasons.arc_summary: Three Iridescent Church convox detectives travel to the logging town of Wrenford to investigate a wave of husk-murders, uncover a commune of Green Father worshippers, and follow a fey stone necklace deep into the mile-tall Verdant Expanse — surviving giant mantises, a laughing wave, and a hostile fey court before returning a lost child home.

seasons.title: The Gloaming Codex
seasons.arc_summary: The convox pivots to an urban investigation in Hallia, tracing fey stone to a jeweler's conference and a mysterious black-raimented ritualist. They discover the Gloaming Codex — a book that transmutes living bodies into fey stone — and are pulled into its pages, battling carnivorous ink before stepping through a stairway into the void.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: In a one-shot set months before the main campaign, three Undercroft workers — Barlow Crane, Grant FireEye, and Gage the Cunning — investigate sabotage aboard the massive moving Strider city of Iomenei. Tracking an elven suspect named Gerhardt into a long-abandoned forsaken sector, they discover an insectoid infestation centered on a dormant engine heart cathedral and must slay a massive Swarm Hive Mother. Though they halt the infestation, the true saboteur remains at large.

seasons.title: Observatory, Slipped
seasons.arc_summary: The Sedecium fire team of Old Man Scrazzy, Lieutenant Foral, and Ozzie investigate a derelict orbital station half-sunk in the slip, uncovering the Thessian Esoterica's tampering and records of a massive magical spike near the Astra's core — then are pulled from retirement for a daring one-shot heist to steal divine essence from the freshly-killed god Tithe before the God Eater Harrow devours it entirely.

seasons.title: Season 1
seasons.arc_summary: A D&D 5e one-shot set on the Finnegan Ring caravan route. Three caravan members — Mango the elven ranger, Doug Donahue the gnome rogue, and Egan the orc druid — are transported along with flautist Erin Proudcloak to a fey swampland by a mysterious mist. There, the fey creature Larunan forces them to fight for his amusement in an arena battle full of chaotic magical effects. The party survives and is returned to the caravan.
